                            Message from the Principal

       The role of Higher Education institution today is not only to impart academic excellence
but also to motivate the students to be life-long learners, critical thinkers and productive members
of ever-changing society. The Deomornoi Degree College strives to enhance all-round
development among the learners and thereby transform them in to potential human resources of
our country. We provide a conducive and holistic learner centric environment where the students
are encouraged and motivated to acquire wisdom to their utmost potential. The talent and skill of
each student need to be identified and nurtured so that he/she is able to reach the new heights.
They need to be provided with a platform to think, explore, express and exhibit their skills is such
a manner which will empower them to negotiate various problematic issues they face in their lives.
The College has been striving hard to make the best possible efforts to inculcate strong values of
academic excellence and extra- curricular activities in the learners who are basically from the
backward and weaker section of the society.
       Deomornoi Degree College is recognized under section 2(f) of UGC Act 1956. The college
has successfully completed first cycle of assessment and accreditation by NAAC in February,
2024 and has been awarded with a commendable “B” grade (CGPA- 2.28).
       The college is affiliated to Gauhati University and we have been following the programme
and curriculum framed by the university. The Gauhati University has implemented the Four-Year
Undergraduate Programme (FYUGP) on the basis of National Education Policy (NEP)-2020 from
the academic session 2023-2024. The programme has been designed to cater to the diverse
academic needs of the students. Hence, I take this opportunity to convey my best wishes to the
students who are going to enter into the new arena of learning.




                                                                         Dr. Gitali Kalita

                     DEOMORNOI DEGREE COLLEGE
                             A BRIEF INTRODUCTION
     Deomornoi is a place of historical significance in the North Western part of Darrang
district. It is located about 15 kms away towards the west of Mangaldai town. The need of an
institution for higher education was felt during the early nineteen nineties by the residents of
the area. Subsequently the Deomornoi Degree College was established in 1993 with the
objective of imparting quality higher education to aspiring students. The college is situated
near the famous Siala Vaishnab Temple on the bank of historically famous Mornoi River. The
College campus comprises of 25 bighas of land with adequate infrastructural facilities. At
present, it has around 1700 students with the staff strength of forty-five employees. The
college is permanently affiliated to Gauhati University and received permission to offer major
courses in almost all the subjects of the arts stream. It offers computer application as a
vocational subject. The college also has a contact centre for M.A. course under IDOL, Gauhati
University.


                       MOTTO OF THE COLLEGE
                            TAMASO MA JYOTIRGAMAYA
                  (Dispelling the darkness of ignorance by the light of learning)
      The college believes in imparting life-skilled and value-based education. Along with
moral upliftment, the students are expected to become useful human resources of the
country through introduction to the challenges of information and technological progress.
VISION: The institute aspires to be a Centre of Excellence by striving to realize the human resource
           potential of the grater Deomornoi area to its fullest in higher education sector.
MISSION: * To help the students specially those who are economically backward.
           * To promote cultural, ethical and intellectual development among the students.
           * Fostering Global Competencies among students.
           * To inculcate Value Education among students.
           * To promote a student-friendly atmosphere for encouraging them to be self-
             reliant and self-employable.
           * To promote extra-curricular activities simultaneously with curricular activities.
           * To mould the students into socially conscious human being.
           * To develop a transparent and responsive administration.

           * To serve as a Distance Education Centre for those who are deprived of regular

              FOUR YEAR UNDERGRADUATE PROGRAMME (FYUGP)

     The Gauhati University is going to implemented the Four Years Undergraduate Programme (FYUGP) from the
     academic session 2023-2024. The Pragramme is based on the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020. The new
     undergraduate programme has been designed to cater to the diverse academic needs of the students. There will be
     options of multiple entries and exits, that is a student can exit from the programme at the end of first or second
     year and then again can enter the programme at a later time and can continue the programme from where he or she
     had left. If a student exits after the successful completion of first year, he/she will be awarded a Certificate, if a
     student exits after successful completion of second year, he/she will be awarded a Diploma and if a student
     successfully completes three years of undergraduate study, he will be awarded a Bachelor’s Degree with or without
     major. Further, a student will be awarded Bachelor’s Degree with Honours or a Bachelor’s Degree with Honours
     and Research at the successful completion of four years of undergraduate course.



                                           Curricular Components.
     The entire FYUGP curriculum is divided into two parts – (1) Core Courses (2) Common Courses.

1. Core Courses: (B.A. with Major and Minor)
   The core courses constitute of Major and Minor courses. Generally, a student needs to choose one major subject and
   one minor subjects.
   (A)    Major Course: The minimum credit requirements for a major course over a three-year period is 60 which
          is divided into 15 papers- Semester1 (One paper), Semester 2 (One paper), Semester 3 (Two papers),
          Semester 4 (Four papers) Semester 5 (Three papers) and Semester 6 (Four papers)
     (B)    Minor Course: The minimum credit requirements for a minor course over a three years period is 24 which
            is divided into 6 papers. A student needs to opt for one minor subject and study one paper each in all the six
            semester.
2. Core Courses: (B.A. with Minors)
   The core courses constitutes of only Minor Courses. Generally, a student needs to choose two minor subjects only.
   (A)    Minor Course: The minimum credit requirements for minor course over a three years period is 84 which is
          divided into 21 papers (including both the major subjects)- Semester 1 (one paper each from the subjects),
          Semester 2 (one paper each from both the subjects), Semester 3 (two papers from the first subject and one
          paper from the second subject), Semester 3 (two papers from the first subject and one paper from the second
          subject), Semester 4 (two papers from the first subject and three papers from the second subject), Semester
          5 (two papers each from the both the subjects), Semester 6 (two papers each from the subjects as well as
          one more paper from any one of the two subjects).

3.   Common Courses :
     As the name suggests, these courses will have to be studied by all students of FYUGP. Together the common Courses
     have an allocation of 36 credits divided over five sub divisions –
     (A)    Value added courses (VAC): Total Credit 6 (Two credits each in 1st, 2nd and 3rd Semester).
     (B)    Ability Enhancement Courses (AEC): Total Credit 8 (Four credits each in 1st and 2nd Semester).
     (C)    Skill Enhancement Courses (SEC): Total credit 9 (Three credits each in 1st, 2nd and 3rd Semester).
     (D)    Multidisciplinary Course (MDC): Total credit 9; (Three credits each in 1st, 2nd and 3rd Semester).
     (E)    Internship: Total credit 4 (A student needs to do internship of four credits in the 5th Semester).

                         RULES AND REGULATIONS
Discipline
    Maintenance of strict discipline inside the college campus is compulsory.
   Use of mobile phones by the students inside the college campus is strictly prohibited.
  Smoking or using intoxicating drugs inside the college campus is strictly forbidden.
    Students found encouraging or participation in ragging of any kind, will be debarred
  from the college.
    Stringent action will be taken against those students who show misbehaviour
  towards any other students, professors or employees of the college.
    Students will face penalty, if they destroy any college properties or involve in any kind
  of activities detrimental to the academic atmosphere of the college.
 Attendance
· A Student will not be allowed to sit for Semester examinations as regular candidate
      if he/she does not attend a minimum of 80% lectures in each subject separately.
· A student who does not appear for the sessional examinations will not be permitted
      to appear for the semester examinations.

              Co- curricular/Extra-curricular activities
    Various co-curricular and extra-curricular activities like indoor and outdoor games,
debate, seminar, cultural programmes, festivals etc. are organized in the college for all
round development of the students. They are encouraged to get themselves involved
with various co- curriculars and extra-curricular activities in the college.
Classrooms:
      Sufficient number of classrooms are available in the college.
Library:
        The college has a library with around 10,000 books, Magazines, Newspapers and
Journals. There is also provision for separate reading rooms for students and
professors. Laboratories: There are separate laboratory rooms for practical subjects
which are well equipped. Internet facilities: The College is connected with internet
facilities provided by BSNL sponsored by UGC.
Study Centre of GUCDOE:
      The College has a study centre of Gauhati University Centre for Distance and Online
      Education (GUCDOE).




College Magazine:
      The college publishes an annual magazine by the name of “Mornoi Jyoti Magazine”
      It is also publishes wall-magazines on special occasions like College Week,
      Saraswati Puja, Fateha-e-Dowaz Daham and Freshmen social. The Sahitya Parishad
      of the college also publishes a Journal of Poetry every year.
National Service Scheme (N.S.S):
     There is a centre of the N.S.S. in Deomornoi Degree college. A number of programmes
and educational excursions are organized by the unit and many of our volunteers have
participated in many states and national level camps. The intending students may join
the N.S.S. which gives an opportunity to develop their personalities and shape their
attitude towards life. Interested students may contact programme officer Sri Nripen
Baishya, Asstt. Prof. Department of History for details information.
 Sports Facilities:

  The college has “Sports and Extra Curricular Cell” under IQAC which fosters a range of sports and
games facilities to promote physical health and wellness among students.

Internal Quality Assurance Cell (IQAC):

The Internal Quality Assurance Cell (IQAC) of Deomornoi Degree College was formed
on 09/09/2021. It is the backbone of our college and it performs as a nodal agency of
the institution to enhance the overall quality of the college. The main objective of the
IQAC is to improve the academic and administrative excellence.


  Grievance Redressal Cell:
  The college has a grievance redressal cell to look into the grievances of the students, guardians,
  teachers and employees of the college. The cell takes appropriate steps for redressal of the genuine
  grievances and complaints in accordance with the guidelines for this purpose.

  Students' Union:
          Deomornoi Degree College Students' Union is the only recognized students' union
          of the college. Its membership is compulsory for every student of the college. The
          students' union of the college has its own constitution according to which election
          is held annually and the executive bodies constituted for the term.
  4.     Eligibility for free admission/ Fee Waiver Scheme:
         1.     Students whose parental annual income is less than Rs. 4.00 Lakhs from all
                source will be eligible to avail this scheme.
         2.     If either of the parents (mother or father) of the student is working in the state
                Govt./Central Govt./ Semi Govt./ State or Central Govt. undertakings, such
                students shall not be eligible under this scheme.
         3.     Students who belong to below poverty line and want to avail free Admission in
                B.A.
                First, 3rd & 5th Semester must have to plant a sapling in a public place. They
                have to furnish copy of their own colour photo (size 4x5 inches) with the
                particular growing plants continuously for three years (B.A, 1st, 3rd and 5th
                Semester). Failing to do so, they will not be entitled for free admission in
                future. Fee waiver scheme is only for regular students having minimum 75% of
                attendance in classes with no back paper in previous examinations.
  5.     Proof of income/ Document Required:
              i) An Income certificate from the Local Revenue Circle Officer Only.
             ii) A declaration from the student that neither of the parent (father or mother) of
       the student is an employee of State/ Central Govt. Department or its undertakings, such
       form shall be devised by the concerned Resisters/ Principal. If such a declaration is found
      to be false, the admission shall be cancelled and fee shall be realized from such students.
 6.     Duties and Responsibilities of Students availing the Scheme:
       Student seeking admission into 1st year needs to plant a sapling at his/ her
 College or at his/her home and should submit the photograph of the same to the
 college. The student has to nurse the sapling and while seeking admission in to
 second year should submit the photograph of the same tree that was planted
 during previous year.
      Student availing the second-year fee waiver benefit during the current year
 should also plant a sapling and will nourish it and submit photograph of the same
 while availing fee waiver benefit subsequently.


                            ADMISSION PROCEDURE
      Application for admission to the college is to be made online through
 SAMARTH e- Govt Portal which is a common platform of Assam State Higher
 Education Department. The students who are willing to take admission in our
 college are instructed to visit the college website and click on the online admission
 icon which will automatically direct them to the SMARTH e- govt portal.
 Accordingly, they need to register in the portal and fill up the online admission
 forms after which they are required to submit the hardcopies of the form to the
 college office. A total of three merit list will be released on the portal and the
 students are requested to visit the portal regularly for updates.
     Candidates selected for admission must bring with them the following original documents
 as well as photo copies at the time of admission:
 a.    Pass Certificate, Registration Card and Mark sheets of both HSLC and HS examinations.
 b.    Two copies of recent passport size photographs.
 c.    Certificate for proof of age (HSLC Admit Card/Certificate)
 d.    A Photo copy of Aadhar Card.
 e.    ST/SC/OBC/MOBC Certificate
 f.    Gap Certificate, wherever necessary, will have to be produced. It has to be issued by a gazette
       officer/head of the institution (Govt. recognized) last attended.
 g.    True Copy of Students Bank Account No., IFS Code, Mobile No. & WhatsApp No. must be
       submitted
COLLEGE UNIFORM: College uniform is compulsory for all students.
        a.     Uniform for Boys: Pant- Black, Shirt- Light Pink.
        b.     Uniform for Girls: Trouser- White, Churidar- Light Pink, Churni-White.
IDENTITY CARD: The college Identity card is issued to every student at the time of
admission. The Identity Card will remain valid for a period of one academic year. The
Identity Card needs to be renewed by the concerned authority every year. In case of any
loss or damage of the card, the matter should be immediately informed to the Principal
 and a duplicate Identity Card will be issued only after proper verification and on payment
of the prescribe fee.

the following scholarships as per rules:
(I) ST/SC/OBC/MOBC (As prescribed by the project Director, ITDP) scholarships.
